messages:
Alex (Growth): Quick heads-up 1: launch Tues 9am PT. Need final adsets for search + retarget and inbound routing to webinar team. Who owns creative swaps?
Mia (Paid): I can own adset reshuffle. Plan: shift 20% budget from prospecting search to retargeting for first 48h, revert if CPA > target.
Devon (Creative): Building 2 hero banners + 15s teaser vid. Will drop assets by EOD Fri.
Sara (Demand): Messaging priority: 'real-world latency & cost benchmarks' angle + CW testimonial. Keep registration copy tight.
Mia (Paid): Search plan: pause DSAs, add exact/phrase for "LLM inference latency" and "inference platform". Create ad variant A (webinar CTA) vs B (whitepaper CTA) for A/B.
Alex (Growth): Add UTMs so we can route signups differently: utm_campaign=webinar_launch_0427 and utm_content={creative_id}.
Mia (Paid): Final UTM: ?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_launch_0427&utm_content={adset}_{creative}
Devon (Creative): Uploaded hero_latency_a.png, hero_latency_b.png, teaser_15s_v1.mp4 to CDN path /assets/marketing/webinar/.
Sara (Demand): Routing rule: utm_content containing "webinar" => SDR_Webinar_A; containing "whitepaper" => SDR_Content_B. Ryan can you confirm?
Ryan (Sales Ops): Confirm. Will add HubSpot rule: if utm_campaign == webinar_launch_0427 AND utm_content contains "webinar" => owner SDR_Webinar_A, SLA 24h; contains "whitepaper" => SDR_Content_B. Tag: paid_search_launch_0427.
Ryan (Sales Ops): Need hidden form field "creative_id" to map creative performance. Marketing add to registration form?
Alex (Growth): Devon add hidden input creative_id populated from utm_content via script.
Devon (Creative): Snippet committed to staging form: <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"creative_id\" id=\"creative_id\"><script>const p=new URLSearchParams(location.search);document.getElementById('creative_id').value=p.get('utm_content')||'';</script>
Mia (Paid): Budget pacing: day1 cap 35% of daily budget for initial burst; day2 70% baseline. Automated rule: pause adset if CPA > $150 for 12h.
Alex (Growth): Add KPI check at 48h: if webinar CTR < 0.7% swap to hero_b + teaser_15s_v1.
Sara (Demand): Retarget lists: 7d engaged, 14d engaged, past demo viewers. Frequency cap 3/day.
Mia (Paid): Audiences: Aud_A_7d, Aud_B_14d, Aud_C_demo. Retarget bids +15% vs prospecting.
Devon (Creative): hero_b includes testimonial overlay + stronger CTA. Preview: https://internal.example/preview/hero_b (internal).
Alex (Growth): campaign-bot schedule campaign create at 08:45 PT, remind @Mia @Devon @Ryan at 08:30.
campaign-bot: Reminder set 1 time=2456868300 (2026-04-27 08:45 PT). Ping at 2456868000 (08:30) to @Mia @Devon @Ryan.
Mia (Paid): I'll monitor first 3 hours and post hourly pulse here.
Sara (Demand): I'll update registration copy with benchmarks + demo CTA by Mon EOD.
Alex (Growth): Final checklist: assets in CDN, UTMs & hidden field wired, HubSpot routing live, CPA pause rules, initial 20% shift to retarget. Call out blockers here. :thumbsup:
Mia (Paid): All set unless CDN upload issues.
Ryan (Sales Ops): HubSpot rules staged and tested.
Devon (Creative): Assets committed, PR #482 for form snippet.
Sara (Demand): Copy pushed to staging, QA Mon 10am PT.
Alex (Growth): Thanks team 1 reconvene Mon after QA.
